instructions.name: claim_validator_fees
docs: Validators call this to withdraw their accumulated fee earnings for a
specific token mint. Transfers from the validator fee pool ATA to the
validator's own ATA and resets their accumulated balance to zero.

accounts.name: validator
docs: The validator claiming their fees — must match validator_earnings.validator

accounts.name: validator_earnings
docs: The validator's earnings ledger for this mint

accounts.name: validator_fee_pool_authority
docs: The dedicated pool authority PDA — signs transfers out of the pool ATA

accounts.name: validator_fee_pool_ata
docs: The pool ATA holding pending validator earnings for this mint

accounts.name: validator_ata
docs: The validator's own ATA — receives the claimed tokens

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can call — they receive the vote account rent as reward

instructions.name: finalize_expired_vote
docs: Anyone can call this after a vote account has expired without consensus.
Always triggers a full refund to the taker.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can call — they receive the vote account's rent as reward

instructions.name: register_validator
docs: Register a new validator pubkey into the 5-slot registry.
Only the authority can call this.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must be the stored authority

instructions.name: remove_validator
docs: Remove a validator from the registry.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must be the stored authority

instructions.name: submit_buy_vote
docs: Cast a vote on a buy-order payout (replaces the single-bot confirm_payout).

accounts.name: validator
docs: Must be a registered validator

accounts.name: validator_fee_pool_authority
docs: Validated against global_state.validator_fee_pool_authority in handler

accounts.name: validator_fee_pool_ata
docs: Pool ATA accumulating the validator 20% share for this mint

instructions.name: submit_sell_vote
docs: Cast a vote on a sell-order payment confirmation.

accounts.name: validator
docs: Must be a registered validator

accounts.name: validator_fee_pool_authority
docs: Validated against global_state.validator_fee_pool_authority in handler

accounts.name: validator_fee_pool_ata
docs: Pool ATA accumulating the validator 20% share for this mint

instructions.name: update_required_votes
docs: Change the vote threshold (1–5, must not exceed validator_count).

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must be the stored authority

types.name: ExpressCloseFailedEvent
docs: Emitted when an attempted close of a trust express fails.

types.name: ExpressClosedEvent
docs: Emitted when express_withdraw fully closes the trust express account.

types.name: ExpressPartialWithdrawalEvent
docs: Emitted when express_withdraw is a partial withdrawal (account stays open).

fields.name: validators
docs: Registered validator pubkeys — empty slots hold Pubkey::default()

fields.name: validator_count
docs: How many non-default slots are currently filled

fields.name: required_votes
docs: Minimum approve votes required to execute a payout (default: 3)

fields.name: validator_fee_pool_authority
docs: The dedicated PDA that has authority over the validator fee pool ATAs.
Derived as: seeds = [b"validator-fee-pool-authority"]
Stored here for reference and verification in the claim instruction.

fields.name: active_vote_count
docs: Number of ValidatorVote PDAs that have been created but not yet executed
or expired. Incremented on first vote for a new reference, decremented
on execution (submit_buy/sell_vote) and on expiry (finalize_expired_vote).
Used by remove_validator to block removal while votes are in flight.

types.name: InstantPaymentPayoutQueuedEvent
docs: Emitted when a fiat payout is queued for processing.

types.name: InstantPaymentPayoutResultEvent
docs: Emitted by confirm_payout with the final success/failure result.

types.name: InstantPaymentReservedEvent
docs: Emitted by instant_reserve when a taker locks tokens into a buy-order escrow.

fields.name: payment_mode
docs: 0 = payment link, 1 = direct transfer with API monitoring

fields.name: payment_link
docs: Flutterwave payment link if payment_mode == 0

types.name: TrustExpressNearlyEmptyEvent
docs: Emitted when a trust express balance drops low relative to active reservations.

types.name: ValidatorEarnings
docs: Tracks accumulated fee earnings for a single validator on a single token mint.
Created lazily on the first vote execution where this validator earns fees
for a given mint — the signing validator pays for initialization.
PDA seeds: [b"validator-earnings", validator_pubkey, mint_pubkey]

fields.name: validator
docs: The validator this account belongs to

fields.name: mint
docs: The token mint these earnings are denominated in

fields.name: accumulated_amount
docs: Accumulated fees owed to this validator, not yet claimed

fields.name: total_earned
docs: Total lifetime earnings for this validator on this mint (never decrements)

fields.name: total_credits
docs: Total number of vote executions this validator has been credited for

fields.name: last_credited_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the last credit

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump for this PDA

types.name: ValidatorVote
docs: Tracks the 3-of-5 validator votes for a single reservation payout.
Created by the first validator who votes; filled in by subsequent ones.
Once `executed` is true the account can be closed by anyone.

fields.name: trust_express
docs: The TrustExpress PDA this vote is for

fields.name: taker
docs: The taker (seller/buyer) whose reservation is being settled

fields.name: reference_hash
docs: Keccak hash of payout_reference — used as PDA seed (always 32 bytes)

fields.name: votes_for
docs: Number of approve votes received so far

fields.name: votes_against
docs: Number of reject votes received so far

fields.name: voters
docs: Which validators have already voted (prevents double-voting)

fields.name: vote_results
docs: What each voter decided (parallel array to `voters`)

fields.name: executed
docs: True once the threshold was reached and tokens were moved

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp when this vote account was created

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Unix timestamp after which the vote fails and a refund is triggered

fields.name: is_buy_order
docs: Whether this is a buy-side (true) or sell-side (false) confirmation

fields.name: bump
docs: bump for this PDA
